function.description: Gathers research data on public preference between two options, based on societal category.

function.name: grocery_store_find_best
function.description: Find the closest high-rated grocery stores based on certain product availability.

rating.description: The minimum required store rating. Default is 0.0. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning_content:
The user wants to find the closest grocery store to Berkeley with at least a 4.5 star rating, selling tomatoes and pet food. I need to use the grocery_store_find_best function. The parameters required are my_location, rating, and products. The user specified "Berkeley" as the location, rating of at least 4.5, and products: tomatoes and pet food. So I'll set my_location to "Berkeley", rating to 4.5, and products as ["tomatoes", "pet food"].

Let me call the function.
